mapper.select: select p.perm_id AS permId, p.perm_code AS permCode, p.perm_name AS permName, p.perm_type AS permType, p.module_code AS moduleCode, p.group_code AS groupCode, p.perm_value AS permValue, p.status AS status, p.sort_no AS sortNo, p.remark AS remark, rp.role_id AS roleId, rp.grant_type AS grantType from expdb.exp_permission p left join expdb.exp_role_permission_rel rp on p.perm_id = rp.perm_id where rp.role_id = #{roleId} order by p.sort_no
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO expdb.exp_role_permission_rel (role_id, perm_id, grant_type, created_by, created_time, remark) VALUES
( #{item.roleId}, #{item.permId}, #{item.grantType}, #{item.createdBy}, NOW(), #{item.remark} )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM expdb.exp_role_permission_rel rp INNER JOIN expdb.exp_permission p ON rp.perm_id = p.perm_id WHERE p.perm_code = #{menuCode} AND p.perm_type = 'MENU'
SELECT DISTINCT rp.role_id FROM expdb.exp_role_permission_rel rp INNER JOIN expdb.exp_permission p ON rp.perm_id = p.perm_id WHERE p.perm_code = #{permCode}
